fixed_camera_aim.notes: 2026-11-03 r2 offsets remain authoritative: vehicle x forward/y left/z up, C-P=[-95,130,0] mm, T-P=[0,0,30] mm, N-T=[7,0,5] mm. P is the pan reference and T is 30 mm above P; the 7 mm is VEHICLE forward. Gimbal x=vehicle left, y=vehicle rear, z=up. The user confirms C is the physical-left lens centre, camera heading vehicle left with zero pitch and roll; its optical right/down/forward axes therefore map to gimbal -y/-z/+x. R_camera_to_gimbal is [[0,0,1],[-1,0,0],[0,-1,0]]. At the defined horizontal leftward geometric zero the nozzle points along gimbal +x; [1,0,0] is not the current standby direction or an encoder reference. Factory stereo gs130w_factory_ce8ac6b9c53913d9ad306b44 provides 1280x1088 undistorted_left_optical from physical-left /image_right_raw; the sidecar rotates rectified XYZ back by R1 transpose. The user requests straight nozzle-ray alignment without water drop or landing correction. Explicit water_aim_policy=straight_ray implements that request and skips water-drop/landing compensation. Geometry, verified stereo frames and real encoder/profile references remain required before automatic operation. Encoder zero/directions/reference, verified stereo depth and remaining commissioning are not fabricated. calibrated=false and all verification flags remain unchanged; no water impact samples or verified hit are asserted.

fixed_camera_landing.notes: UNMEASURED. Separate from moving-camera pixel tables. Measure angular corrections at a complete nominal-pan/nominal-tilt/nozzle-distance grid (at least 2 values per axis). Every row requires a unique measurement_id, measured=true, nominal_pan_deg, nominal_tilt_deg, nozzle_distance_m, angle_correction_deg=[pan_delta,tilt_delta] and actual measured_impact_error_m=[x,y,z]. Every interpolation cell also needs a distinct strictly-interior validation measurement with commanded_angles_deg equal to the interpolated target and actual measured_impact_error_m within the declared acceptance radius. These are actual water tests at the same installation and pump setting; no extrapolation or pressure/gravity guessing. Bind all calibration/profile/reference IDs after measurement. No sample values are supplied because none have been physically measured.

evidence.geometry: 2026-11-03 最新尺寸r2替换旧值。原点改为用户本次测量的水平轴参考P，T在P上方30mm；不再令P=T。原始车体系x前/y左/z上：C-P=[-95,130,0]mm，T-P=[0,0,30]mm，N-T=[7,0,5]mm。相机/喷嘴零位继续朝车左；云台基系x车左/y车后/z上，程序参数分别为[0.130,0.095,0]m、[0,0,0.030]m、[0,-0.007,0.005]m。喷口总位置N-P在车体系为[7,0,35]mm。C已确认物理左眼镜头中心；用户最新确认相机朝车左且没有仰角/侧倾，据此填入去畸变左眼光学系到云台的旋转矩阵。喷嘴几何零位定义为水平朝车左，方向填[1,0,0]，不据此填写实际编码器参考。
evidence.axes: 历史确认：电机2/ZDT水平，电机1/PD42俯仰，两轴直驱；工作范围水平左右各90度、俯仰水平向上0至60度。工作范围不是本次编码器坐标限位，故未填写运行axes。水平零位朝车左；30度为待机俯仰角，不是几何零位。本次实际编码器参考未读取。
evidence.stereo: 已绑定厂商EEPROM参数 gs130w_factory_ce8ac6b9c53913d9ad306b44（config/stereo.factory.json），输入物理左眼/image_right_raw、右眼/image_left_raw，单眼1280×1088。当前观测由R1转置把整流XYZ转换回undistorted_left_optical；安装瞄准和区域映射均以这一真实帧为待验收绑定。区域配置camera_coordinate_frame/position_frame均为undistorted_left_optical，RegionApproach已按两种明确光学帧分别绑定；DetectionArray的header.frame_id与rectified标志必须一致，且实际XYZ帧必须精确匹配配置。绑定工厂ID和坐标系不等于完成独立距离、相机姿态、曝光同步或水流验收；所有calibrated/verified仍按各草稿未通过状态保留。
evidence.water: 用户明确要求喷嘴按直线对准目标，不作水流下坠或落点补偿。已实现显式water_aim_policy=straight_ray，几何与执行器profile必须使用同一策略；仍需真实双目帧验收、轴参考、完整几何及安装/泵档身份。未测落点保持未测，water_impact/physical_hit标志不改为通过；不宣称已经可以自动灭火。区域靠近算法和实测水程门未在本轮扩展。
evidence.vehicle_reference: C已确认左镜头中心；P相对车头中点地面垂足后250mm、右55mm、上270mm。换算C=[-345,75,270]mm；T=[-250,-55,300]mm；几何零位N=[-243,-55,305]mm。未猜测相机俯仰/横滚或水流落点。
evidence.orientation: 用户声明相机水平朝车左，俯仰0°、横滚0°。光学x右对应车前、y下对应地面下方、z前对应车左：R_camera_to_vehicle=[[1,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,-1,0]]；与既有vehicle→gimbal换基结合得R_camera_to_gimbal=[[0,0,1],[-1,0,0],[0,-1,0]]。这不是独立角度仪精密测量，也不是编码器零点验收。

相机和喷嘴几何零位朝车左；云台基系x车左/y车后/z上，pan +z、tilt -y。实际编码器零点及方向尚需对应。
